warnings: This is an application-level candidate catalog, not confirmed discovered MCP tools.
Resource capabilities are not equivalent to callable tools.
No server endpoints, tool calls, code paths or experiments were verified.
Credential issuance, financial authorization, directives and binding findings require formal authority and independent controls.
Proposed names may overlap with earlier mcp/tool-proposals.json and require semantic reconciliation before promotion.
